status: FROZEN at the commit that first adds this file, after amendment 1 and BEFORE any Stage-2 compute. It freezes the three Stage-2 studies (N numerical/bootstrap overlap, C calibration failures, K convergence/observability), their controls, the analysis rules applied to them, and the rule that will choose configurations 2 and 3 from study K; configurations 2 and 3 themselves are frozen by a later amendment before their first development run. Executor choices under the delegation.
seeds: shared_development_studies range 930000-949999 of the contract: pseudo seeds 930000 (N2), 931000 (N3), 930001-930004 (C1), 930100-930199 (C2), 930300-930339 (C3, fixed split of 930000), 932000 (C4); pseudo-experiment bootstrap seeds 5001-5040; real-data bootstrap seeds 1-50 (the s5e replicas b1-b50 are the unjittered partners) and 1-2 re-run as controls; jitter seeds 1-20 (base constructions) and 101-150 (replica partners)

study_N_numerical_bootstrap_overlap.question: does the refit-per-replica bootstrap already contain the estimator's rounding-scale sensitivity, and how large is that sensitivity on the data, at nominal and at a physical departure

design.N1_data: the real data under R: the unperturbed product (control), 20 edge-safe jitters of it (seeds 1-20), and 50 bootstrap replicas b = 1-50 each re-run with jitter seed 100 + b; the unjittered partners are the s5e data replicas b1-b50 (assess/data/boot); replicas 1 and 2 are re-run unjittered as controls
design.N2_nominal_pseudo: pseudo experiment 930000 (nominal truth): base, 20 jitters, 40 replicas b = 5001-5040 each unjittered and with jitter seed 100 + (b - 5000)
design.N3_departure_pseudo: pseudo experiment 931000 (GiBUU/GENIE E_avail shape, a = 1): the same design

estimands_per_functional.sigma_num_base: SD over the 20 jitters of the base construction
estimands_per_functional.sigma_num_rep: SD over replicas of (f_bj - f_b0) / sqrt(2)
estimands_per_functional.sigma_smooth_sq: the covariance over replicas of f_b0 and f_bj (the rounding-independent part)
estimands_per_functional.absorption_ratio: sigma_num_rep^2 / sigma_boot^2 (the share of the bootstrap variance that is rounding noise)
estimands_per_functional.consistency: sigma_num_rep / sigma_num_base (is the noise at the replicas the noise at the base construction)

study_N_numerical_bootstrap_overlap.decision_rule: the numerical component is ABSORBED by the bootstrap for a reporting definition if, over its reported functionals, the median of sigma_num_rep / sigma_num_base lies in [0.7, 1.4] (the replicas carry the base construction's rounding noise at its size) and sigma_boot^2 >= sigma_num_rep^2 for >= 95% of functionals; the variance decomposition sigma_boot^2 = sigma_smooth^2 + sigma_num_rep^2 is reported with its sampling error. If not absorbed, the numerical component is declared as an independent probabilistic component with variance sigma_num_base^2 (from >= 20 jitters of the construction it applies to) and added once; in either case T3 is evaluated against the total sigma of the selected definition
study_N_numerical_bootstrap_overlap.interpretation: the jitter is a probability model over equally valid float32 representations of the same inputs (each value uniformly within +-1/2 ulp, grid membership preserved and checked); a spread under it is an algorithmic uncertainty of the estimator's output, not a physical fluctuation
controls: N1 unperturbed product equals s5e assess/data/data_R.npz bitwise (xsec_flat)
N1 replicas b1, b2 re-run unjittered equal s5e boot_b1, boot_b2 bitwise
every jittered product records zero grid-membership changes (the tool refuses otherwise)
every product's refinement classifier parameters and OmniFold estimator parameters equal R's (metadata, not launcher flags)

study_C_calibration_failures.the_six: s5e assessment (assess_receipt.json, 40 fresh nominal experiments, sigma from the 100-replica bootstrap of development experiment 700000): pull SD outside 1 +- 3 SE for EW41 (1.42; 68% coverage 0.375), J85 (1.42), J162 (0.65), J206 (1.50), J215 (1.78), J232 (1.45); EW41, J206 and J215 also out in development (pull SDs correlate 0.48 between the samples); review round 2 M1

hypotheses_tested.H_sigma_varies: the bootstrap sigma of one experiment is not the sigma of others (heteroscedasticity over experiments): C1 bootstraps 4 more nominal experiments (930001-930004, 40 replicas each) beside N2 (930000) and s5e 700000
hypotheses_tested.H_ensemble_estimate: the 40-experiment pull SD is itself noisy: C2 adds 100 nominal experiments (930100-930199) to the 60 existing R nominal experiments (s5e K1_R 700000-700019, assessment 800000-800039), giving 160 (SE of a pull SD 0.056)
hypotheses_tested.H_split: the per-experiment MC split (half A unfolding MC, half B pseudo-data source, background C/D) adds variance the single-experiment bootstrap does not resample: C3 runs 40 nominal experiments (930300-930339) with the fixed split of 930000; the fixed-split ensemble SD against the varying-split SD isolates it
hypotheses_tested.H_departure_scale: sigma depends on the truth: N3 (GiBUU) and C4 (W3, 932000, 40 replicas) bootstraps at physical departures against the s5e departure ensembles
hypotheses_tested.H_bias: the mean pull (bias) of each of the six over the 160 nominal experiments, separately from its scale

study_C_calibration_failures.analysis: for each of the six and for all reported functionals of RD1/RD2: pull SD with (a) sigma of 700000, (b) the mean of the six per-experiment sigmas (700000, 930000-930004), with sampling uncertainties; the CV of sigma over the six experiments; fixed-split / varying-split ensemble SD ratio; mean pull and its SE; the departure-point bootstrap sigma over the nominal sigma, beside the departure-ensemble SD
study_C_calibration_failures.disposition_rule: each of the six is recorded as ADDRESSED if a tested hypothesis accounts for its excess (its pull SD with the corrected sigma construction lies within [0.80, 1.25], T5's band, on the 160 experiments), or UNRESOLVED with its measured pull SD; the corrected construction becomes a proposal for the interval design of Stage 3 (it is checked there on construction experiments and validated only on fresh ones); resolving the numerical study alone does not discharge any of them, and a pooled pass cannot

design.B0_classifiers_200_iterations: noise-free asimov_same (the full MC unfolds its own reco-passing rows reweighted by r; no background, so R and B0 coincide), 200 iterations, truths nominal, GiBUU/GENIE E_avail a = 1, q3_given_eavail_w a = 0.3, W1 NuWro/GENIE E_avail a = 1, W3 NuWro/GENIE (pT, p_parallel, E_avail) a = 1
design.capacity_probe_100_iterations: the same with n_estimators 400, num_leaves 31 on the three OmniFold estimators, 100 iterations, truths GiBUU, q3, W3 (a diagnostic probe of the capacity dimension, like s5e D5; not an estimator configuration)

metrics_per_iteration: per reporting definition (EW, J, H2 reported cells): median, 90th percentile and maximum |relative residual|; the median over cells with a departure > 1% of |bias| / |departure| (the T2 proxy) and the recovered fraction

detector level: chi2 between the unfolded result's reco fold and the folded truth with the analysis-exposure Poisson variance of the measured side (EW projection every iteration; 5D at the snapshots), the explained fraction 1 - chi2 / S_dep, and S_dep itself (the departure's visibility after detector response at the actual exposure)
improvement and deterioration: the iteration of the minimum of each metric and its change from k = 5 to 200, per alternative
study_K_convergence_observability.no_optimality_claim: a finite scan that does not reach a target is reported as such

configuration_selection_rule.inputs: study K noise-free metrics and study N/C sigma scales; the per-iteration costs measured by the s5e products (pseudo experiment about 40 s + 55 s per iteration, data about 40 s + 126 s per iteration, 32 threads; capacity 400/31 about 3.4x per iteration) re-measured on the study-K products
configuration_selection_rule.M_of_k: for reporting definition P in {J, H2} and iteration k, M_P(k) = the maximum over the four development alternatives (GiBUU, q3, W1, W3) of the noise-free median over reported cells (departure > 1%) of |bias| / |departure|
configuration_selection_rule.affordability: K_afford = the largest k whose complete remaining-work forecast (construction, validation at the Stage-2 provisional sample sizes, verification and repair reserves, joint inference separately) fits the remaining pools; computed in the Stage-2 receipt before any choice
configuration_selection_rule.configuration_2: R with B0 classifiers and K2 iterations: K2 = the smallest k in {10, 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200} with k <= K_afford and M_J(k) <= 0.25; if none, the smallest such k with M_H2(k) <= 0.25; if none, the k <= K_afford minimizing M_H2(k). If K2 = 5 is not improved upon (M at K2 >= M at 5 for both J and H2), no configuration 2 is frozen
configuration_selection_rule.configuration_3: R with capacity 400/31 on the three OmniFold estimators and K3 iterations, K3 chosen by the same rule on the capacity probe (k up to 100, cost scaled by the measured factor); frozen only if M at K3 is below configuration 2's M at K2 by >= 20% relative on the definition configuration 2 was chosen for; otherwise slot 3 stays unused
configuration_selection_rule.then: each frozen configuration gets development checks (a later amendment: nominal closure, the development alternatives on background-inclusive pseudo experiments, the numerical probe on data, the bootstrap sigma) and at most two development revisions each, each prompted by a recorded unmet development requirement

R_verification: the Stage-2 receipt re-reads the metadata of every R product it uses (s5e and new): refinement classifier parameters (400/31, random_state 45), OmniFold estimator parameters (F2), input digests, seeds, and for the new products the tool's grid-membership check
